 Frozen salmon recalled due to potential risk of listeria 
 Frozen salmon recalled due to potential risk of listeria By 6abc Digital Staff Sunday, October 18, 2026 2:43PM Share A recall has been issued on a frozen seafood product that was sold in Pennsylvania and New Jersey.
 The FDA says Starfish Seafood Premium Cold Smoked Norwegian Salmon carries a risk of listeria.
 The affected products come in a vacuum-sealed plastic package, and are meant to be stored in the freezer.
 No illnesses have been reported yet.
